description: Versioned Romanized Hinglish -> Devanagari transliteration table loaded by roadmap.hinglish.HinglishDataEngine. Object key order is significant: when two Romanized spellings map to the same Devanagari form, the first spelling listed becomes the canonical reverse-map rendering. Keep the order consistent (e.g. 'nahi' before 'nahin', 'accha' before 'achha').
